title: Serpent Fang Toxin
summary: Coated hits or a thrown cloud can apply delayed Poison damage.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action, one dose on the active weapon set for 10 turns. Both equipped weapons are coated if dual wielding. A separate set needs a separate dose. Replaces dipping. On a hit one target per attack can be affected. The pinned source reports Advantage against being Poisoned does not affect this save.
fields.On hit: DC 13 Constitution save avoids 1d6 Poison at the end of the target’s next turn.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Creates a 3 ft radius Serpent Venom area. DC 13 Constitution save against the delayed toxin, which lasts 1 turn. The linked source does not give a separate area duration.
fields.Crafting: Suspension of Snake Venom plus any Vitriol.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
